en: Yeah, yeah. I guess these things happen. Anyway, let's get back to what we were talking about.
Besides shows like this, when do you get the chance to meet your fans in person?
Well, I do have handshake events and things like that, just as you said.
Oooh. Do any of the fans ever get overzealous, shall we say?
A Tokyo idol once told me a fan wouldn't let go of her hand and started saying some pretty obscene things. What would you do in that case?
That would be inexcusable! I can't believe anyone would do something like that.
I know, right? I mean, you may be an idol, but you're still an innocent young lady. Something like that would be pretty shocking for you, huh?
Yes, I think I would be very taken aback. It would be just awful!
Yes, I think even I would be shocked if somebody did that to me. Hey, should we try a little experiment?
I want you to grab my hand and don't let it go. Then start saying obscene things to me, okay?
Aww, I was just kidding! Don't beat me up now!
Well, what could I do? I mean, it's not like we can do background checks or anything on the guests that come to these events.
Hm. Nothing to do but cry, huh?
I'm afraid so, yes.
But, I guess I can kind of understand where the guy is coming from, meeting the object of his obsession like that. Am I right, people?
Hehe, just kidding! Never mind that one, okay? Please forgive me, everybody!
Obscene things? Like what?
Oh. I don't really know, but probably something like, "That's a nice rack you've got," or "Why don't we go get a room?" You know how it is.
Really? What else?
Hey now, enough with this line of questioning!
You're an idol, so I bet your agency has rules against you dating, right?
No, not really. But I'm so busy right now, I don't even have time to think about it.
But you must be popular with the boys at school, right? I know if I was your age, I'd be falling all over myself.
You're too kind.
When it comes to guys, what's your type, anyways?
Even though this is your fourth time on the show, we still don't click at all, do we?
I like the big, strong type. Someone I can depend on.
Oh, yeah? Then whenever the two of you were together, you'd look like Beauty and the Beast, wouldn't you?
I guess that leaves me out, then. I'm decidedly un-beast-like.
Come on, you're not even gonna throw me a bone? This is your fourth time on the show⑬I thought you'd at least give me a small ray of hope.
I like the kind, gentle type. Someone I can feel relaxed around.
And what about looks? Does that mean you like the slender type of guy?
Yes, I think I do.
How about me then?
Hey, just what are you trying to say!?
I like the funny type. Someone who can really make me laugh.
Wait a minute. You're talking about me, aren't you!?
I had no idea you felt that way about me, Haruka-chan!
Well, I'm sorry to have to tell you this, but my heart belongs to my audience. I'm afraid you and I can never be. Please don't take it too hard!
Oh, that's all right.
She sounds absolutely heartbroken, folks.
Well, it looks like we're just about out of time for today. Thanks for our chat, Haruka-chan!
This time, if you get 85 smiles or more, I'll give you an exclusive Nomu-san cell phone strap!
I was really nervous, but I had a lot of fun. I still hope you can vote for me!
If I was boring, it was Nomu-san's fault. I did my very best. I hope you vote for me!
That's right. It's all my fault! Everything is my fault!
This is your fifth and last time on the show, isn't it? I really appreciate all your hard work.
I really appreciate being invited.
Keep up the good work when you go out there today.
On this show, you'll be talking about the Princess League. It'll be a good plug for you, too.
We want you to try and get 90 smiles this time. That way, you can go out with a bang.
And, this being your last time, it's customary for you to invite somebody to be the next guest. We'd like for you to invite T-Set.
Yes. And even if they're not really your friends, could you say they are for the sake of the show?
And what's a slang term for a low rider?
LOLO!
Hahaha. You're all just too good to me, folks! Thank you for playing along.
Let's get started then, shall we? Today's guest will be joining us for the fifth and final time now, folks. It's the marvelous singing sensation, Haruka Sawamura-chan!
What a beautiful smile! Your popularity is just shooting through the roof now, isn't it?
But this is your fifth time on the show!
Okay! Seeing as this is your last day, I thought we could finally talk about the Princess League.
As I'm sure you all know, the Princess League is a hit show that pits idol against idol. The pressure must be intense!
Yes, it is. I get really nervous every single time.
That's because it's win or go home, isn't it? I bet there's a lot of tension and drama between you and your opponents backstage.
Do you ever get picked on by the other contestants on the show?
Looks like Haruka-chan is at a loss for words.
I guess things are so bad you can't even talk about it on-air, huh?
No, never. We all just try to play fair and do our best, that's it.
Are you sure? No thumbtacks on your chair or ripped outfits or anything?
Oh no, nothing like that.
Okay, so you don't get picked on. Does that mean you're the one harassing everybody else?
No, of course not!
Sometimes. If I run into my opponents backstage before the show, they might taunt me or something like that.
And what do you do in retaliation?
I don't do anything in retaliation!
Come on. You can tell me! I'll keep it a secret.
Well, I guess I sometimes do glare back a little.
What!? That's it? Come on now...
I'll leave it to your imagination.
Aww, if that's all you're gonna say, everybody's gonna imagine the worst, you know!
Of course! You have to give us a little more than that, Haruka-chan.
...No, I'll just leave it at that.
Wow, you're stubborn, aren't you?
When you're on the Princess League, your fans are up pretty close, aren't they? Hey, kind of like they are now, here in the audience!
See that? You're a pro at this now!
Yeah, yeah. Well, I guess these things happen. Anyway, let's get back to what we were talking about.
The Princess League audience members get pretty wild with enthusiasm, don't they?
Oh yes. It really encourages me to keep going and give them a great show.
I bet the audiences are much smaller when you're not performing on TV. Does that kind of thing make it harder for you to do your best?
Hey, you're just gonna leave me hanging!?
When I'm on stage, I always try to give it everything I've got. The number of guests doesn't affect my motivation.
Really? But doesn't a smaller audience at least take some of the pressure off?
Not at all. I still try my absolute best!
Okay, okay. I see you aren't going to budge.
A big crowd does really get me going. For example, I'm sure to make my movements a little bigger so everyone can see.
Oh? Does that mean you slack off when the audience is smaller?
Of course not! When the audience is smaller, I'm able to look into the eyes of each guest and really appreciate every person there.
Oh, okay. I get it. A smaller audience is much more intimate, isn't it?
Actually, the fewer the guests, the harder I try. I feel pressure to keep the audience members I have and not let any of them escape!
As an idol, I'm sure you've experienced all different kinds of shows.
You might have to perform in the rain, on the roof of a department store. I even bet some shows you can count the number of guests on one hand.
Sometimes it is like that, yes.
Being an idol sure doesn't sound like an easy job.
You know, when I think of the Princess League, T-Set are the idols that first come to mind. What are they really like?
Well, when we see them on TV, they look so outgoing and flamboyant.
But as your rivals on the Princess League, what are they like when you meet them backstage?
That just won't do, Haruka-chan. This is the fifth time you've been on the show, you know!
They're just as they appear on TV: bright and beautiful.
That may be, but I think you're every bit as beautiful, Haruka-chan.
I'd certainly be hard-pressed to choose between the two of you, that's for sure!
I'm kidding! Just joking around! Of course I'd choose you, Haruka-chan.
To be honest, they're pretty aggressive towards me.
Hold on! Are you really sure you want to say that on-air!? That comment could get you into some trouble later, you know!
That's all you have to say!?
T-Set and I get along great, actually.
You mean, you go out to eat together and stuff?
Well, nothing like that, no.
Text each other, then?
We don't do that either.
Hm. Exactly how do you get along, then?
Since this is the last time, if you get 90 smiles or more, I'll give you an exclusive Nomu-san cell phone strap!
After five times on the show, I'm grateful for all the time we had together! I hope you vote for me!
Yes, thank you for coming on the show so many times!
Thank you, everyone! I hope you vote for me!
Please continue to lend me your support!
Isn't she cute, everybody? I hope you all continue to support her too!
Wow! You did it, Haruka! You managed to break 90 smiles!
Ahh. The result wasn't as high as we hoped.
Okay, Haruka-chan. Before we say goodbye, we'd like you to invite a friend to be our next guest here on the show. Who would you like to invite?
Let's see. I think I'd like to invite...
What's the matter? Can you not think of anyone!?
Oh, I'm sorry! I'd like to invite the T-Set girls!
Hmm. Are you sure you're really friends?
I think I'd like to invite the P-Set girls.
P-Set? Uh... Don't you mean T-Set?
Oh, I'm so sorry! I meant T-Set!
I think I'd like to invite the T-Set girls.
I think I'd like to invite the T-Pet girls.
T-Pet? Uh... Don't you mean T-Set?
All right! You heard it, folks! Our guests next time will be the girls of T-Set!
Haruka-chan, thank you for coming on our show. And five times at that!
Thank you very much for having me!
Thank you, Haruka-chan! And that does it for all five segments!
Thank you so much for having me on the show!
You did an outstanding job! I'd say that was a big success, both for you and for "Love to See You Smile."
Thank you, Haruka. That does it for all five segments.
Thank you so much for having me on the show.
Yes... But I'm afraid you just weren't ready for "Love to See You Smile." You had some real rough moments out there.
Ah, Uda-san. Sawamura-san is here.
Hello, everyone!
Oh, Haruka-san! How have you been?
Fine, thank you. I'm excited to be here today!
And we are excited to have you! I know we can always count on you to do a great job.
I'll certainly do my best!
By the way, are you comfortable with how handshake events work now?
Actually, I'm still a little nervous about these kinds of things.
Not a problem. Would you like a reminder on how everything is going to go today?
No, that's all right. I don't want to keep the guests waiting. Should we get started?
Yes, excellent. All right, people! We're about ready to get started!
I'll start letting the guests in!
Yes, I think so. I want to make sure I get it right.
All right. Let me give you a rundown of how it's going to go.

To raise fan satisfaction level, shake hands with as many fans as you can before time runs out. At the same time, make sure to keep an eye on the staff member who keeps the line of fans moving along. Lastly, be on the lookout for super fans wearing happi coats. They can raise the satisfaction level more than regular fans, but if disappointed, they can also lower it dramatically.

While it's important to shake hands with each fan for as long as possible, the line must also be kept moving. This is the job of a staff member named Taro Hagashi, known as "The Remover." He discourages fans from lingering too long and removes them if necessary.

A fan who is removed leaves in fear, and the fan satisfaction level drops.
Luckily, "The Remover" is also a big fan of yours.

Use <Action:Button_L1@Handshake> to flash him a smile and he'll turn to mush and forget to do his job. You can use this to your advantage by smiling at the right time.

When the command to shake hands appears on the screen, hold down <Action:Button_Square@Handshake>. You will continue to shake hands with the fan until you release <Action:Button_Square@Handshake>.
During this time, the fan will speak to you. Use <Action:Button_DPad_Left@Handshake><Action:Button_DPad_Right@Handshake><Action:Button_DPad_Up@Handshake><Action:Button_DPad_Down@Handshake> to choose your response.

To raise the fan satisfaction level, choose the reply that matches the color of the fan's comment.
